consumer: The per-monster perception check Creature::sees(avatar) asking 'does this monster see the avatar right now?', whose boolean the noticed-flag reports.
scope: Monster-side line-of-sight/perception of the avatar (each monster sees the player), evaluated over monsters in the rendered area; not on-person, not a display tint.
decisive_source: src/creature.cpp::Creature::sees — computes a yes/no from range, light, line of sight, night-invisibility, hide/crouch concealment, and a final map::sees LOS test, returning whether one creature sees another.
divergence: A monster within range of the avatar but with a wall blocking line of sight (or standing in darkness): Creature::sees returns false, yet a position-distance re-derivation would wrongly flag it as having noticed the avatar.
